CII.name: CO2 Impact Index
CII.description: Higher value means worse environmental impact (high CO2, low biodegradability/recyclability).

CEI.name: Cost Efficiency Index
CEI.description: Higher value means more cost-efficient for packaging (low cost per unit, high durability).

MSS.name: Material Suitability Score
MSS.description: General suitability for packaging based on strength, capacity and recyclability.

final_recommendation_score.name: Final Recommendation Score
final_recommendation_score.description: Weighted aggregate of environmental goodness, cost efficiency and suitability.
